products.notes: JL Audio owner's manual (Garmin download server). Continuous power 125 W; recommended amp 50-175 W RMS. Usable range: 50 Hz-5 kHz (48 dB/oct), 60 Hz-5 kHz (24 dB/oct), 70 Hz-5 kHz (12 dB/oct). Min. recommended sealed enclosure 12 L (0.424 cu ft). Rear displacement 0.382 L. Reference efficiency 0.304%. Le not published. JL C7 manuals' suggested 3-way starting points: woofer LP 400 Hz LR24; midrange HP 480 Hz / LP 3500 Hz LR24; tweeter HP 4500 Hz LR24 (-1 dB). 2-way: woofer LP 2700 Hz, tweeter HP 4000 Hz LR24. Passive crossovers not recommended (active/DSP only).
